LIVE-DEFECT ROUND (Carbon, task #30) — RE-CAPTURED after six defects the owner found on a real canvas paste were fixed at their sources. InlineNotification +0.506 (96.581 → 97.087) and cellsCompared 7488 → 4944 — a VOCABULARY CHANGE, named: Carbon's notification icons ship `<title>error icon</title>` inside the svg, and `<title>` is NON-PAINTING metadata (SVG 1.1 §5.4). The capture now drops SVG title/desc/metadata at the source; the six per-kind glyphs promote as REAL icon assets, so 5 path parts + 1 title part per icon leave the compared tree.
